context.title: Dunkirk (2017 film)
sentences: "Dunkirk" was released digitally on 12 December 2017, and on 4K Ultra HD, Blu-ray, and DVD on 18 December in the United Kingdom and 19 December in the United States.
Dunkirk is a 2017 war film written, directed, and produced by Christopher Nolan that depicts the Dunkirk evacuation of World War II.
Its ensemble cast includes Fionn Whitehead, Tom Glynn-Carney, Jack Lowden, Harry Styles, Aneurin Barnard, James D'Arcy, Barry Keoghan, Kenneth Branagh, Cillian Murphy, Mark Rylance, and Tom Hardy.
Principal photography commenced on 23 May 2016 in Dunkirk, France. Production then continued for four weeks in Urk, Netherlands.

context.title: Urk
sentences: Until 1475, the High and Low Lordship of Urk and Emmeloord was in the hands of the Van Kuinre family.
The important economic pillar of the village is the fishery.
After the IJsselmeer was formed, the people of Urk continued to fish on the North Sea.

context.title: North Sea
sentences: Cod, haddock, whiting, saithe, plaice, sole, mackerel, herring, pouting, sprat, and sandeel are all very common in the North Sea and are fished commercially.
The North Sea yields millions of cubic metres of sand and gravel from the ocean floor each year, and rolled pieces of amber may also be found on nearby coasts.
Storm surges threaten, in particular, the coasts around the North Sea, especially those of the Netherlands, Belgium, Germany, and Denmark.

context.title: Metabolism
sentences: One central coenzyme is adenosine triphosphate (ATP), the universal energy currency of cells.
Catabolism is the set of metabolic processes that break down large molecules.

context.title: Catabolism
sentences: Classic catabolic hormones include cortisol, glucagon, and adrenaline. Additional hormones with catabolic effects include cytokines, orexin, and melatonin.

context.title: Adrenaline
sentences: The major emotion studied in relation to adrenaline is fear.

context.title: Cortisol
sentences: In general, cortisol stimulates the synthesis of new glucose from non-carbohydrate sources; this process is known as gluconeogenesis.

context.title: Insulin
sentences: Insulin lowers blood glucose by promoting glucose uptake and storage, thereby opposing processes such as gluconeogenesis that raise blood glucose.
Frederick Banting and Charles Herbert Best were the first to isolate insulin from dog pancreas in 1921.
Researchers later succeeded in extracting insulin from the adult cow pancreas.
